import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a count plot for survival based on class and sex
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=data, x='pclass', hue='survived', palette='Set1', dodge=True)

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Survival Count by Passenger Class', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(ticks=[0, 1, 2], labels=['First Class', 'Second Class', 'Third Class'], fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Survived', loc='upper right', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
